target.title: fix(worker): roll back partial Hetzner provisioning
target.body:
## Summary

- roll back a Hetzner server when post-create readiness fails, treating already-absent resources as successfully cleaned up
- continue through retryable server-type fallbacks after a successful rollback
- delete only newly created canonical lease-owned SSH keys; retain shared workspace, reused, and custom keys
- persist exact key cleanup work when immediate deletion fails, retry it with coordinator backoff, and finish it before workspace reprovisioning
- persist the exact server and key IDs when rollback deletion fails, defer cleanup without hot-looping, and retry server-before-key so an attached key is never removed first

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/761

## Verification

- `npm test --prefix worker` — 762 tests passed after rebasing onto current `main`
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — 51 command docs, 69 providers, 202 Markdown files, and the generated docs site
- whole-branch and focused autoreview rounds; final review reported no actionable findings

No new live Hetzner canary was run because the credential session remains locked. The regression suite exercises successful rollback, server and key 404 idempotency, fallback continuation, durable server/key ID recovery after rollback failure, server-before-key cleanup, exact-ID persistence/retry, retry backoff and early-alarm suppression, and shared/reused-key retention.
